description.value: Rolly's is a 120-seat, fully licensed diner in Hope, BC, built in 1986 to welcome travellers arriving via the new Coquihalla Highway. It serves all-day breakfast alongside a broad lunch and dinner menu of burgers, steaks, seafood, pasta, and kids meals, and has employed a stable local team of 40+ for decades. Sitting at the junction of Highway 1 and the Coquihalla corridor, it is a natural refuelling stop for cyclists crossing the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fetched and functional, providing address (888 Fraser Ave, Hope BC V0X 1L0), phone (1-604-869-7448), and detailed menus. The site copyright reads 2014-2017 and all customer reviews are from 2016-2017, indicating the website has not been updated in roughly a decade, though OSM flags looks_closed=false. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; takeout/pickup is confirmed by a customer quote hosted on the website ('You can also order for pick up anything off the menu even breakfast').
concerns: Website copyright and all customer reviews are dated 2016-2017; the site has not been visibly updated in approximately 8-9 years. Current operating status and menu/pricing should be field-verified.
OSM record lacks address, phone, and email — all contact details sourced solely from the (outdated) website.
GPS coordinates on the website contact page (49.377510, -121.441842) differ slightly from the OSM record (49.377882, -121.4425103), though both point to the same building area.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, long-running diner in Hope at a major highway junction — a natural and useful stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley corridor.

wow_evidence: 120-seat, fully licensed diner in Hope, BC, built in 1986...stable local team of 40+
